driver.kind: steam turbine driving a two-pole generator
driver.running: synchronised at rated speed until the trip

barring_gear.engages: when the rotor has come to rest

speed_input: 60-tooth wheel on the shaft, read by the vibration instrument
keyphasor: single notch in the shaft; zero of the 1X phase
supports: tilting-pad journal bearings in pedestals cast into the concrete block

tracking_filter.type: single-pole low-pass on the demodulated 1X vector

slow_roll.taken: on the barring gear before the last start-up
